plan.label: Simple Sentences Cloze: Level 1 Balanced Mix

utterances.text: Finish the sentence: I see the ___.
Finish the sentence: She has the ___.
Finish the sentence: The cat sat ___ the mat.
Listen. The cat sat on the mat.
Finish the sentence: The dog is ___.
Finish the sentence: ___ are in the van.
Listen. They are in the van.
Finish the sentence: The cat ran ___ the shed.
Listen. The cat ran to the shed.
Finish the sentence: ___ is the cat?
